text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...How boring. There's just nowhere near 
enough excitement."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the walk back from hanging out with 
Nakayama Festa, she muttered a few words 
out of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The kind of thrill Nakayama Festa craves 
is rarely found anywhere outside of 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Well, if you could find it anywhere, it 
wouldn't be near as exciting or thrilling, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I wondered if there was anything I 
could do to help, something suddenly came 
to mind.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...So, an aquarium? What kind of thrill 
are you gonna find in a peaceful place 
like this?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you expect me to get all 
hyped up watching a dolphin show—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, is it by any chance *that*?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The words from the flyer I received 
before, 'Thrilling impact! Sharks right 
before your eyes!?'...
choice_data_list: Apparently you can try feeding the animals

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, it's not like you're diving 
into the same aquarium tank or anything, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Now, if the opponent were the size of a 
whale, that'd be a whole 'nother story."
choice_data_list: Even so, going that far is...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, fine. Since we're already here. 
It'll at least kill some time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Over there, huh... wait, whoa. Looks like 
there are two different events.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Thrilling! Sharks Right Before Your 
Eyes!" and "Adorable Penguin Race."
choice_data_list: Let's go with sharks as planned!

When you mention a race, it piques my 
interest...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's see just how "intense" 
this really is.

text_block_list.name: Person in Shark Costume
text_block_list.text: Open wide, and ROAR~!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! Ahahaha.

text_block_list.name: Person in Shark Costume
text_block_list.text:
Yes, so this one here is called a great 
white shark. Has anyone ever seen a real 
one before?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Oi, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What's that about intense power?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking another look at the event details, 
I notice something written below the bold 
"Thrilling! Sharks Right Before Your 
Eyes!"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
""~Learn About Ocean Creatures~ *Staff in 
a shark suit will provide commentary"... 
it read."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* I'm not gonna apologize, but 
still... Even so, this is--

text_block_list.name: Person in Shark Costume
text_block_list.text:
And so, sharks in the ocean are super 
fast! Oh, hey there, Umamusume over there!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Are you talking about me?

text_block_list.name: Person in Shark Costume
text_block_list.text:
I have this plush shark hat here... Could 
you put it on and chase the kids around 
just for a little bit?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why should I—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Wah! A shark Umamusume is chasing after 
me!? Eeeek!

text_block_list.name: Person in Shark Costume
text_block_list.text:
The venue was originally prepared so 
people could run around, but I thought 
having an Umamusume would give it even 
more impact...

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: ...? Mr. Shark, aren't you gonna chase me?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ………… ...Damn it all!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, squirts! Run away with everything 
you've got! Unless you wanna get eaten!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She may have looked annoyed, but Nakayama 
Festa still entertained the kids right 
until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you serious? It might be a race, 
but they're penguins."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"No risk either. You can already tell it's 
gonna be boring."
choice_data_list: Still, a race is a race...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...So, what of it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a drag. Don't complain if I fall 
asleep halfway through, alright?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooooo!! Go, right there! Accelerate! 
Penpen, you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Event Attendant
text_block_list.text:
Now, in the lead right now is Number 3, 
Penpen-chan! Right behind her is Number 5, 
Gonta-kun! And closing in from the rear 
comes Kin-chan too~!

text_block_list.name: Event Attendant
text_block_list.text:
By the way, gentoo penguins are said to 
swim at speeds of up to 35 km/h!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
35 km/h underwater... Haha! For having 
such a cute face, those penguins are 
something else...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This penguin race is getting intense, so 
intense...!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haa... Who knew it was gonna be an 
underwater race? Got me way more fired up 
than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Races really are great... The prize is 
just a keychain, but it feels surprisingly 
valuable.
choice_data_list: I'm glad to see you enjoyed yourself.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Right back at ya. Your eyes were dead 
serious too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, if it's a race, I gotta be 
honest, I'd rather run it myself."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That burning thrill— I can only feel it 
through these legs of mine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa flashed a fearless smirk, 
her eyes taunting me as if to say, "Told 
ya so, didn't I?"
